Subject: Handoff: Activation MAP & Execution Timeline for Clearinghouse

Hi Elena / Tomas —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, attaching the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1) and a first-pass SOW draft so we can align on milestones, owners, and target dates. This thread will live in my mailbox as the primary handoff from Sales -> CS/Implementation.

High-level goal: go-live (production inference) for Clearinghouse Billing Assistant by 2027-01-24 with phased staging ahead of that date.

Key milestones (proposed):
- Milestone A — Kickoff + prework sign-off: target 2026-11-17 — Owner: Clearinghouse PM (Elena) / Redwood CS (Monica)
- Milestone B — Integration sprint (API + auth + network): 2026-11-22 to 2026-12-10 — Owner: Redwood Integration (Marcus) / Clearinghouse Eng (Tomas)
- Milestone C — Staging validation & acceptance tests: 2026-12-12 to 2027-01-05 — Owner: Clearinghouse QA / Redwood CS
- Milestone D — Go-live cutover window: 2027-01-24 — Owner: Clearinghouse Ops / Redwood Ops

Acceptance criteria per milestone are in the attached MAP spreadsheet. Risks called out: network proxy changes, SSO certificate exchange, and sample data availability for QA.

Requested next steps:
1) Please review the attached MAP_v1.xlsx and SOW_Clearinghouse_draft.pdf and flag any date/owner conflicts by EOD Wed 11/11.
2) Confirm a 60–75 minute kickoff on the week of 11/15; we propose Wed 11/17 10:00 AM PT. Agenda attached (kickoff-agenda.pptx).
3) Tomas — can you share your security contact for the SOC 2 questionnaire? We’ll route the paperwork and the pre-kickoff checklist (attached) to them.

Deliverables from Redwood for kickoff: finalized MAP v1.1, integration runbook stub, and a signed SOW (we can accept DocuSign).

If that all sounds good I’ll mark items as tentative and circulate an updated MAP after any quick changes.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

- 11/24 start for the integration sprint works for us (agree with Tomas on pushing two days). I’ll update the MAP accordingly.
- I’ve attached a one-page "Pre-kickoff readiness checklist" to ensure clearinghouse has required sample payloads, firewall/ip allowlist, test accounts, and an SSO cert exchange window. Please review and add anything we missed.
- For the SOW: we prefer to get a final SOW signed before staging access. If Clearinghouse can turn around signature in 3–5 business days after kickoff, we’ll schedule staging validation.

Proposed updated milestone dates (short summary):
- Kickoff: 2026-11-17 (confirm)
- Integration sprint: 2026-11-24 -> 2026-12-12
- Staging validation: 2026-12-14 -> 2027-01-08
- Go-live: 2027-01-24

I’ll paste an owner/responsibility row here for quick visibility:
- Redwood CS (Monica) — overall activation owner, acceptance coordination, runbook export
- Redwood Integration (Marcus) — API adapter configuration, test harness setup
- Redwood Sales (Soojin) — commercial follow-up, SOW sign-off escalations
- Clearinghouse PM (Elena) — schedule decisions, sample data, acceptance sign-off
- Clearinghouse Eng (Tomas) — API connectivity, network/security coordination

- Integration sprint: 2026-11-24 -> 2026-12-12 — Owners: Marcus / Tomas
- Staging validation & acceptance: 2026-12-14 -> 2027-01-08 — Owners: Clearinghouse QA / Monica

1) Monica to run readiness checklist with Clearinghouse and confirm sample data availability by 11/12.
2) Soojin to push updated SOW to DocuSign (link below) and share sign target (3–5 business days after kickoff).
3) Marcus to prepare API adapter checklist and provide test endpoints by 11/19.
